title: On fractional critical problems with multi-polar Hardy potentials
summary: We investigate the existence of positive solutions to fractional equations presenting a double criticality: a multi-polar Hardy-type potential and a Sobolev critical nonlinearity. The nonlocal nature of the operator and the absence of explicit ground states for the single-pole equation stand as major difficulties. We overcome these obstacles by passing to an extended formulation of the problem and by establishing sharp asymptotic estimates for the solutions in the case of a single pole.
